Q: How can I take a picture of an entire page of a website (desktop) using JavaScript? A:

Yes you can do this from your phone. On iOS, make a screenshot in Safari, tap it and you can select "full page", then share from there to whatever you need it. It's ridiculously easy these days.

Q: I tried scraping a part of wiki and it's taking the wrong section A:

You search ul in wrong way.

You search h2 with text Dialogue and next you search sibling ul but ul with dialogs is not sibling because it is inside div.

There is sibling ul but after Location and you get text from location.

You have to search ul in <div id="needolin-dialogues> (without "sibling").

You may even search directly li in this div - ie. using CSS selector.

soup.select("div#needolin-dialogues li")

Working function:

    def scrape_enemy_dialogue(self, url):
        #print("url:", url)
        soup = self.fetch_page(url)

        dialogue = [
            li.get_text(strip=True) 
            for li in soup.select("div#needolin-dialogues li")
        ]
        #print("dialogue:", dialogue)

        return dialogue

By the way:

the same with find() find_all()

    def scrape_enemy_dialogue(self, url):
        soup = self.fetch_page(url)

        dialogue = []

        div = soup.find("div", id="needolin-dialogues")
        # div = soup.find("div", {"id": "needolin-dialogues"})

        if div:
            dialogue = [li.get_text(strip=True) for li in div.find_all("li")]

        return dialogue

Q: net::ERR_ABORTED 500 (Internal Server Error) in bootstrap A:

The problem you are facing is Probably from the file you uploaded or linked to your application.

Debugging Strategy: Try Loading the file directly using its link.

Trying to access one of these static files directly also fails and just shows the message “The page cannot be displayed because an internal server error has occurred.

Solutions: In some cases, the site might be referencing the FontAwesome package which uses the WOFF file type. This happens when your server is using an older version Tech than you are using. In the older version this MIME type was not registered so it required a manual entry in the configuration. In the newer IIS, this is handled natively, and the manual configuration is now causing a problem rather than remediating one.

Check the web.config file for a reference to woff(or Filetype)

for example:

and comment out or remove this line.

Refresh the page in your browser and it should now load correctly.

see more here: https://www.isjw.uk/post/software/css-javascript-image-500-error-iis/

Q: The connection manager will not acquire a connection because the connection manager OfflineMode property is TRUE A:

I believe this error is happening because TNS entry is mission in that machine.

Please verify if oracle TNS for the database is present in that machine or not?

You can find the TNS file in the below path.

C:\Oracle\product\11.2.0\client_1\network\admin

If it is not there and try one more time.
